Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IOCL Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IOCL Research Associate positions is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or a Ph.D. in Chemistry (Organic, Inorganic, Analytical, or Physical Chemistry) to be eligible for the Research Associate positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for candidates applying for the Research Associate positions is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/Women and OBC categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the salary for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Research Associate post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 66,960 per month. This amount may also be as per the DBT/DST sanctioned research project grant available.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: Indian Oil Corporation (IOCL) has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the Research Associate position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate positions at IOCL will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience for the interview round.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the IOCL Research Associate recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Research Associate positions at Indian Oil Corporation are temporary in nature, associated with a DBT/DST sanctioned research project.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Research Associate positions will be posted at the IndianOil R&D Centre in Faridabad, Haryana.

faq.question: Q10. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates should apply by sending their detailed CV via email to the specified email address: [email protected] before the last date of application.
